title: Repair packing handles growing comment budgets without losing grouped items
steps: Run the real comment builder with a refused two-item prefix that fits after a short third item, plus group-only, suffix and refusal fixtures.
expect: A refused prefix does not force an extra turn when a longer candidate fits the real builder.
An item refused alone is retained when a containing group fits; order is preserved and turns are minimized.
Unusable items are named, invalid builder errors propagate and the original prompt/footer remains unchanged.
fence: Do not change prompts, consent policy, comment order or the comment builder's own budgets.

tests: a later short comment can make a refused prefix fit the real builder budget
an item refused alone is retained when a group containing it fits
packing minimizes turns across feasible suffixes and keeps original order
only items without any usable covering turn are omitted
invalid comment errors still propagate from the real builder
